INSERT INTO "__viborm_batch_refs" ("batch_id", "ref_key", "ref_value") VALUES (?, ?, CAST(((CAST(? AS INTEGER) + ?)) AS TEXT)) ON CONFLICT ("batch_id", "ref_key") DO UPDATE SET "ref_value" = EXCLUDED."ref_value"
UPDATE "g2_counters" SET "id" = (CAST((SELECT "ref_value" FROM "__viborm_batch_refs" WHERE "batch_id" = ? AND "ref_key" = ? LIMIT 1) AS INTEGER)) WHERE "id" = ?
